title: SWF bitmap export: real DefineBitsLossless2/JPEG2 instead of gray placeholders
description: Imported bitmaps publish as gray placeholder rectangles (compile.ts:246-259, acknowledged TODO) and are skipped entirely inside sprites (sprite.ts:126), so Test Movie does not reflect imported artwork even though import/stage placement (0024) and FLA asset storage (0033) work. Decode the library item dataUri, emit DefineBitsLossless2 (PNG/GIF) or DefineBitsJPEG2 (JPEG) plus a shape with a clipped-bitmap fill referencing the character, and place that. Honor allowSmoothing and compressionType from BitmapItem. Note 0031 was marked done but this gap remained. See docs/09-bitmaps-imported-artwork.md, docs/15.
